children: NeOnc Technologies entered Securities Purchase Agreements for a registered direct offering expected to raise approximately $15 million, pricing each common share and accompanying warrant at $4.20. The deal includes 2,610,715 shares, pre-funded warrants for up to 960,715 shares at a $0.0001 exercise price, and warrants to purchase up to 3,571,430 shares that are immediately exercisable at $4.20 and expire in five years. The company also signed a Placement Agency Agreement with Roth Capital Partners and A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners, paying a 7.0% fee on gross proceeds. Closing is expected on September 10, 2026, with proceeds earmarked for working capital, general corporate needs, and redeeming Series A Convertible Preferred Stock.
